# EXP Bank Calculator

> EXP Bank Calculator estimates gem growth at a fixed 0.50% daily compound rate. It runs in the browser, publishes read-only JSON metadata, and exposes WebMCP tools for arbitrary calculations.

## When to use this calculator

Use this calculator when a person needs to estimate a starting gem balance after a duration, compare a target balance with a starting balance, estimate time to reach a goal, or identify the Discord rank threshold for a balance. Use the calculate-exp-growth WebMCP tool when browser WebMCP is available. Otherwise, use the formula and inputs in /index.md or the interactive homepage.

## Public JSON resources

- [Calculator info](https://torturado.github.io/api/info.json): Rate, formula, time units, and supported agent access methods.
- [Rank thresholds](https://torturado.github.io/api/ranks.json): Discord rank names and minimum gem balances.
- [API section guide](https://torturado.github.io/api/llms.txt): Scoped endpoint guidance.
- [Developer docs section guide](https://torturado.github.io/docs/llms.txt): Scoped integration guidance.
- [Authentication](https://torturado.github.io/auth.md): Public access and static hosting limits.

These JSON resources are static and do not accept request parameters. For arbitrary calculations, call the browser WebMCP tool calculate-exp-growth with currentGems and any optional goal or duration fields.

## WebMCP tools

- calculate-exp-growth: Calculate future gems, profit, growth percentage, income estimates, time-to-goal, and rank thresholds. Required input: currentGems. Optional inputs: goalGems, additionalGems, years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds.
- list-exp-ranks: Return the rank thresholds and daily rate used by the calculator.

## Deployment limits

The current site is a static GitHub Pages export. It cannot run request-time HTTP calculation code, return JSON errors for arbitrary invalid requests, negotiate Accept: text/markdown with Vary: Accept, or provide an MCP Streamable HTTP handshake. The static files and WebMCP tools above are the supported agent interfaces.
